deferrals.rationale: The first performance trend artifact is derived from the existing checked-in baseline, which predates the extended environment metadata rules. New baseline captures record these fields in run_benchmarks.py, and the next approved reference baseline must carry them directly.

The checked-in trend baseline exceeded the freshness window before an approved reference-hardware recapture was available. This defers only stale-baseline freshness for the existing benchmark ids; local threshold budgets and smoke benchmark execution remain blocking, and the next approved reference baseline must replace this deferral.
